notes.title: React Hooks Summary
notes.content:
useState: State management in functional components
useEffect: Side effects, runs after render
useContext: Access context without Consumer wrapper
useCallback: Memoize functions
useMemo: Memoize values
useRef: Persist values across renders without triggering re-render

Rules of Hooks:
1. Only call hooks at top level
2. Only call hooks from React functions

notes.title: Nielsen's 10 Usability Heuristics
notes.content:
1. Visibility of system status
2. Match between system and real world
3. User control and freedom
4. Consistency and standards
5. Error prevention
6. Recognition rather than recall
7. Flexibility and efficiency of use
8. Aesthetic and minimalist design
9. Help users recognize, diagnose, and recover from errors
10. Help and documentation

notes.title: SQL JOIN Types
notes.content:
INNER JOIN: Returns matching rows from both tables
LEFT JOIN: All rows from left + matching from right
RIGHT JOIN: All rows from right + matching from left
FULL OUTER JOIN: All rows from both tables
CROSS JOIN: Cartesian product
SELF JOIN: Table joined with itself

Example:
SELECT s.name, c.title FROM students s INNER JOIN courses c ON s.course_id = c.id

notes.title: Big O Notation Cheat Sheet
notes.content:
O(1) - Constant: Array access, hash table lookup
O(log n) - Logarithmic: Binary search
O(n) - Linear: Linear search, single loop
O(n log n) - Linearithmic: Merge sort, quicksort average
O(n²) - Quadratic: Bubble sort, nested loops
O(2^n) - Exponential: Recursive fibonacci
O(n!) - Factorial: Permutations

Space complexity matters too!

notes.title: Process States in OS
notes.content:
New → Ready → Running → Waiting → Ready → Running → Terminated

Process Control Block (PCB):
- Process ID
- Process state
- Program counter
- CPU registers
- Memory limits
- List of open files

Context switch: Save state of old process, load state of new process
